name: errand-complete
description: No callback was ever offered and every question is backed by a callee turn. The errand is done in one leg.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Good morning. I'm an automated assistant calling on behalf of Amina Otieno, with her permission.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: What is the earliest appointment you have with Dr Mwangi?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Tuesday the fifteenth at half past nine.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Can you arrange a sign language interpreter for the appointment?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: Yes, we book those through the county service, that's arranged.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Do you need the referral letter before the appointment?

turns.speaker: callee
turns.text: No, bring it on the day, that's fine.
